title: Shook
description: When Mia, a social media star, becomes the target of an online terror campaign, she has to solve a series of games to prevent people she cares about from getting murdered.

title: Crowsnest
description: Police discover video footage of nomadic cannibals attacking a group of vacationing friends.

title: Confessional
description: After two mysterious deaths at a college on the same night, seven students receive invitations to reveal what they know about the deceased inside a confessional booth hidden on campus.

title: V/H/S/94
description: A mysterious VHS tape reveals a sinister cult that has prerecorded material that uncovers a horrifying conspiracy.

title: V/H/S/99
description: A teen's home videos lead to a series of horrifying revelations.

title: V/H/S/85
description: A heart-pounding journey into the grim underbelly of the forgotten '80s through five tales of terror on a taped-over made-for-TV documentary.

title: #Horror
description: Preteen girls face a night of terror when their obsession with a disturbing online game goes too far.

title: Virus-32
description: A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.
